## Summary

Describe the user-visible or numerical change.

## Validation

List the exact commands run and relevant numerical tolerances or sample counts.

## Checklist

- [ ] Focused tests cover the change.
- [ ] `pytest tests/unit -q` passes, or the reason it was not run is documented.
- [ ] Public API/configuration changes are documented.
- [ ] Generated reports, solver outputs, plots, and local paths are not committed.
- [ ] Third-party material retains its license and notice.
